texts.au_digest: Hurira mu ncamake imwe ya buri munsi
texts.au_escalate: Bitemejwe mu masaha {hours}? Bijya ku muntu ukurikiyeho.
texts.au_paused: Byahagaritswe: {name} yakoze cyane kurusha ibisanzwe uyu munsi. Iguma ifunze kugeza uyifunguye.
texts.title: Uko nyir'ubucuruzi abibona kuri mudasobwa igendanwa
